### Forest {#review-app-2}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      16 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 3 ago 2026 - 11 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _jokal3112_, 11 ago 2026, 1/5: "Absolute worst customer service I've ever experienced. My bike was broken, so I couldn't end the ride — the timer just kept running. I then tried every way possible to reach support: emailed 5 times (no response), called twice (couldn't get through), tried live chat twice (it's frozen), and even the email address listed on the website is no longer a working address. Not a single contact channel actually works. On top of that, I regularly lose minutes from my 1,200-minute subscription to broken bikes, and reported bugs never get reimbursed. I had to buy an extra 500-minute bundle, which is now being drained by the exact same issue. The referral bonus I was promised for friends who signed up also never showed up. An app you can't actually reach anyone through when something goes wrong isn't usable. Can't recommend this right now."
            2. _HL46645_, 3 ago 2026, 1/5: "This is an objectively terrible app. It has constant issues that cannot be put into a review. It constantly lets you down and is significantly worse than competitors. This wouldn’t be an issue if it didn’t resort to buying monopolies in areas to force people into paying for its horrible service who have no other choice. It will constantly let you down and make you pay for the privilege. Awful"
            3. _Sarahharki_, 9 sept 2026, 2/5: "Forest bikes are great - a bit heavy but a comfy ride. Good manoeuvrability. However, I generally always choose other electric bikes as Forest are very expensive, costing my double on a short journey than Voi or Lime. Also I have found the app to be very glitchy. hence the 2 stars"
<!--/ir-theme-->

### Notion {#review-app-3}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      13 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 20 abr 2026 - 13 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _.oliviaaa_, 15 ago 2026, 1/5: "There's a lot of issues on mobile compared to the desktop version. For example, when you select a paragraph and try to delete it instead of holding down the delete button, it doesn't delete. Sometimes even when you hold down the delete button, a letter or two doesn't get deleted. It's generally laggy and without a premium subscription, you can't even upload a single video as the file max is 10mb and most videos are over that. You have to find a site and register to embed the videos instead. Overall greedy platform. Used to be good until it became buggy and you're can't upload a video without the app's premium subscription being shoved down your throat."
            2. _AS-QV_, 13 ago 2026, 1/5: "Lot of bugs like emoji selection failures, Formatting text on the phone. Notion used to be the minimalist note taking app with seamless UX. Now, it's like any other tech company. Product is pushing to add more features for the cost of reduced usability to boost internal KPIs. Save Notion or I'm out to Obsidian!"
            3. _narwhalez123_, 4 ago 2026, 1/5: "Was a big fan of this app a couple of years ago, i find the organisation so satisfying. I re-downloaded it recently and the lag and ai-centric design has really made it into one of the worst note taking apps i have ever used! You can’t do anything without the screen freezing and it feels like it’s just turned into a generic ai chatbot app with a little bit of organisation on the side (that doesn’t even work most of the time??) it’s so disappointing to see and I hope the creators import an ai-free version for notetakers who actually think for themselves, perhaps the lack of ai will make some of the other features less laggy."
<!--/ir-theme-->
